clues.title: Cross-Border Vendor Excel/WeChat Quote Comparator
clues.quote: Comparing supplier quotes in Excel takes way too much time because every factory sends different MOQ tiers, packaging specs, and FOB vs EXW terms in messy spreadsheets or chat messages.
clues.persona_context: Cross-border e-commerce buyer sourcing from 8-15 suppliers per product launch
clues.input_data: Vendor Excel sheets, PDF quotes, and chat screenshots with MOQ/shipping terms
clues.output_data: Normalized landed-cost comparison table with margin flags

clues.title: Safe-Zone Aware Multi-Platform Campaign Asset Resizer
clues.quote: Before every campaign, one poster has to be turned into a horizontal banner, vertical story, and video cover. Every time I resize, the title or subject gets cropped by platform UI overlays.
clues.persona_context: E-commerce social marketer publishing daily across TikTok, Instagram, and Shopee
clues.input_data: Master campaign design + target platform aspect ratios
clues.output_data: Safe-zone validated horizontal, square, and vertical assets
